description: This file defines the RooHandler class, a provider for interacting with Roo Code Cloud API, including methods for creating chat streams, handling reasoning details, model management, and image generation.

classes.name: RooHandler
classes.description: A provider class for interacting with Roo Code Cloud API, supporting chat completion streaming, reasoning details, model management, and image generation.

methods.name: getSessionToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current session token from CloudService or returns 'unauthenticated'.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a streaming chat completion request with Roo-specific parameters, handling reasoning details and streaming output.

methods.name: getReasoningDetails
methods.description: Returns the current reasoning details accumulated during the last message stream.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Generates a message stream for a given prompt and messages, handling reasoning details, tool calls, and usage metrics.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt synchronously, updating the API key before request.

methods.name: loadDynamicModels
methods.description: Fetches and caches available models from the Roo API.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves model information from cache or provides fallback defaults.

methods.name: generateImage
methods.description: Generates an image via Roo's image API or provider, requiring authentication.
